title: 💛 नीरा की मुरझाई तुलसी और मग का टूटा हत्था... पानी कैसे पहुँचेगा? #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🤔 क्या नीरा अपनी मुरझाई तुलसी तक दो मग पानी पहुँचा पाएगी? #kids #story
😮 नीरा ने भरा मग बालकनी के दरवाज़े तक पहुँचाया, फिर सब छलक गया... #kids #kahani
description_hook: नीरा की तुलसी मुरझा रही है और मग उससे भी भारी है। बालकनी पर वह अपना तरीका खुद निकालती है।

characters.name: नीरा
characters.description: six years old, short black bob with a red hair clip, yellow kurta and blue shorts, a faint scar on her left knee

scenes.narration: बालकनी में नीरा की तुलसी मुरझाई है, पानी चाहिए अभी।
scenes.caption: Neera's tulsi plant is wilting on the balcony. It needs water right now.
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, stands on a narrow apartment balcony beside a clay pot holding a drooping tulsi plant with dry cracked soil, a red plastic bucket near the railing, morning sunlight falling across the floor.

scenes.narration: नीरा ने मग भरा और दरवाज़े तक पहुँच गई। फिर सब छलक गया। वह बुदबुदाई: बूँद, बूँद, एक दो तीन।
scenes.caption: She got the mug to the door, then it all sloshed out. Drop, drop, one two three.
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, walks from the kitchen doorway onto the balcony holding a steel mug brimming with water, water spilling over her hands and onto the floor tiles, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: फिर उसने दोनों हाथों से मग पकड़ा। कदम फिसला, आधा पानी गिरा।
scenes.caption: She gripped the mug with both hands. Her foot slipped and half the water went.
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, grips a steel mug with both hands on the wet balcony floor, one bare foot sliding sideways, water leaping out of the mug in an arc, morning light.

scenes.narration: अगली बार नीरा के मग का हत्था टूट गया। बाल्टी में बस दो मग बचे। अब पानी कैसे जाएगा?
scenes.caption: Next go, the handle of Neera's mug snapped. Two mugs left. How will water get there?
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, crouches on the wet balcony floor beside a steel mug lying on its side with its handle snapped off, a red plastic bucket holding only a little water, morning light on the puddle.

scenes.narration: नीरा ने खाली बोतल भरी और ढक्कन में तीन छेद किए। मेरे साथ गिनो! बूँद, बूँद, एक दो तीन।
scenes.caption: Neera poked three holes in a bottle cap. Count with me: drop, drop, one two three.
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, sits on the balcony floor filling a clear plastic bottle from the red bucket, the blue cap in her other hand with three small holes in it, thin streams of water sprinkling out, morning light.

scenes.narration: मिट्टी गीली हुई और पत्तियाँ सीधी खड़ी हो गईं। नीरा खिलखिला उठी। मेरे साथ ज़ोर से बोलो!
scenes.caption: The soil went dark, the leaves stood up, and Neera laughed. Say it out loud with me!
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, stands beside the tulsi pot laughing, the leaves of the plant now upright above dark wet soil, the holed bottle in her hand, morning sunlight on the green leaves.

scenes.narration: बूँद, बूँद, एक दो तीन।
scenes.caption: Drop, drop, one two three.
scenes.image_brief: Neera, a six-year-old girl with a short black bob and a red hair clip, in a yellow kurta and blue shorts, holds the holed bottle above the tulsi pot on the balcony railing, water falling in separate thin drops onto the soil, soft golden light.

title: 😅 कबीर ने टहनी से अपना झूला बनाया, और वह बीच से चटक गई... #kids #story
title_alts: 🤔 कौन देगा कबीर को झूले पर बारी, जब पार्क की लाइन गेट तक हो? #kids #kahani
✨ कबीर, चार बच्चे और पार्क का एक ही झूला... पहली बारी किसकी? #kids #story
description_hook: पार्क में झूला एक और बच्चे कई। कबीर लाइन में खड़ा है, और अंधेरा करीब आ रहा है।

characters.name: कबीर
characters.description: seven years old, cropped black hair, green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, a small mole on his right cheek

scenes.narration: कबीर को अंधेरा होने से पहले झूले पर बारी चाहिए।
scenes.caption: Kabir wants one turn on the swing before it gets dark.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, stands at the edge of a neighbourhood park looking at a single wooden plank swing hanging from a big tree, long late afternoon shadows stretching across the dusty ground.

scenes.narration: पार्क में झूला सिर्फ़ एक है। कबीर लाइन में खड़ा रहा। उसने कहा: दस धक्के, फिर अगली बारी।
scenes.caption: The park has just one swing. Kabir stood in line. Ten pushes, then the next turn.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, stands in a short line of children behind the single wooden swing, another child swinging high on it, low evening sun behind the tree.

scenes.narration: कबीर ने खाली कोने में टहनी से झूला बनाया। टहनी बीच से चटक गई। कोई और झूला नहीं था।
scenes.caption: Kabir built a swing from a twig in an empty corner. It snapped. No other swing.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, squats in an empty corner of the park holding two halves of a snapped twig with a short piece of rope tied to it, dry leaves around his feet, evening light.

scenes.narration: अब झूले के पीछे चार बच्चे और आ गए। लाइन गेट तक पहुँच गई। किसकी बारी पहले?
scenes.caption: Now four more kids are behind him. The line reaches the gate. Whose turn first?
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, stands in front of the swing with four more children lined up behind him, the line reaching the iron gate of the park, evening light on their faces.

scenes.narration: कबीर ने सौदा रखा: दस धक्के, फिर अगली बारी। वह हर बच्चे को धक्का देगा। मेरे साथ गिनो!
scenes.caption: Kabir offered a deal: ten pushes, then the next turn. He pushes everyone. Count with me!
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, stands behind the wooden swing pushing a smaller child on it while holding up his fingers to count, the waiting children watching, evening light.

scenes.narration: झूला रुका ही नहीं, कबीर की बारी भी आई। धक्का देना ज़्यादा मज़ेदार निकला। अब मेरे साथ बोलो!
scenes.caption: The swing never stopped and Kabir got his turn too. Pushing was more fun. Say it with me!
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, sits on the wooden swing swinging forward while another child pushes him from behind, the rest of the children clapping beside the tree, warm low sunlight.

scenes.narration: दस धक्के, फिर अगली बारी।
scenes.caption: Ten pushes, then the next turn.
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a seven-year-old boy with cropped black hair and a small mole on his right cheek, in a green striped t-shirt and grey shorts, pushes a child on the wooden swing while the waiting children count on their fingers, the park gate behind them, golden evening light.

title: 😳 ध्रुव ने नीला क्रेयॉन जेब में छिपाया, फिर वह बीच से टूट गया... #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🤔 क्या ध्रुव की लंबी नदी एक टूटे नीले क्रेयॉन से पूरी होगी? #kids #story
💙 ध्रुव के दो पन्ने और मेज़ पर एक ही नीला क्रेयॉन... नदी कैसे बहेगी? #kids
description_hook: ध्रुव को दो पन्नों पर एक लंबी नदी बनानी है, और मेज़ पर नीला क्रेयॉन एक ही है। फिर वह टूट जाता है।

characters.name: ध्रुव
characters.description: six years old, wavy black hair, blue school shirt and khaki shorts, a chipped front tooth

scenes.narration: क्लास में ध्रुव दो पन्नों पर एक लंबी नदी चाहता है। वह गुनगुनाया: दो पन्ने, एक नदी।
scenes.caption: In class, Dhruv wants one long river across two pages. Two pages, one river.
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, a six-year-old boy with wavy black hair and a chipped front tooth, in a blue school shirt and khaki shorts, sits at a low wooden classroom desk with two blank sheets of paper spread in front of him and a small tin of crayons at the edge of the desk, daylight coming from a window on his left.

scenes.narration: ध्रुव ने नीला क्रेयॉन जेब में छिपाया। मेज़ पर नीला एक ही है। पर उसकी नदी अधूरी रही।
scenes.caption: Dhruv pocketed the blue crayon. Only one blue on the table. His river stayed unfinished.
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, a six-year-old boy with wavy black hair and a chipped front tooth, in a blue school shirt and khaki shorts, slips a blue crayon into his shirt pocket while looking down at his two blank sheets, other children drawing along the same long desk, daylight from the window.

scenes.narration: उसने दबाया और क्रेयॉन बीच से टूट गया। साथ बैठी लड़की को भी नीला चाहिए। अब दोनों क्या करें?
scenes.caption: He pressed hard and the crayon snapped. The girl beside him needs blue too. Now what?
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, a six-year-old boy with wavy black hair and a chipped front tooth, in a blue school shirt and khaki shorts, presses a blue crayon hard onto his sheet with the crayon broken into two pieces under his fingers, a girl at the same desk holding a yellow crayon over her own empty page, daylight.

scenes.narration: ध्रुव ने चाहत बदली। उसने अपना पन्ना लड़की के पन्ने से टेप किया। मेरे साथ बोलो: दो पन्ने, एक नदी।
scenes.caption: Dhruv changed his wish. He taped his page to hers. Say with me: two pages, one river.
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, a six-year-old boy with wavy black hair and a chipped front tooth, in a blue school shirt and khaki shorts, presses a strip of tape along the edge where his sheet meets the girl's sheet so they form one wide double page on the desk, half a blue crayon lying between them, daylight.

scenes.narration: आधे क्रेयॉन से दोनों ने बारी-बारी नदी रंगी। ध्रुव को अपनी नदी और लंबी लगी। अब मेरे साथ बोलो!
scenes.caption: Half a crayon each, taking turns. His river looked even longer. Say it with me now!
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, a six-year-old boy with wavy black hair and a chipped front tooth, in a blue school shirt and khaki shorts, and the girl at the desk colour one long blue river that runs across both taped sheets, each of them holding half of the broken blue crayon, daylight from the window.

scenes.narration: दो पन्ने, एक नदी।
scenes.caption: Two pages, one river.
scenes.image_brief: Dhruv, a six-year-old boy with wavy black hair and a chipped front tooth, in a blue school shirt and khaki shorts, and the girl hold up the two taped sheets together showing one long blue river running from one page onto the other, the classroom desk and window behind them.

title: 🤔 क्या बीना उस लंबी रस्सी में कूद पाएगी, या बाहर ही रहेगी? #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🥹 बीना ने अकेले कूदकर देखा, रस्सी के बिना मज़ा नहीं आया... #kids #story
✨ बीना, गली की लंबी रस्सी और बड़ी लड़कियाँ... जगह किसे मिलेगी? #kids #kahani
description_hook: गली की लंबी रस्सी में बीना को भी कूदना है, पर बड़ी लड़कियाँ कहती हैं जगह पूरी है।

characters.name: बीना
characters.description: five years old, two short braids with blue ribbons, orange frock, a chipped red bangle on her wrist

scenes.narration: गली में बीना उस लंबी रस्सी में कूदना चाहती है।
scenes.caption: In the lane, Beena wants to jump in that long skipping rope.
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, stands at the edge of a narrow concrete lane between houses watching four older girls swing a long skipping rope, late afternoon sun on the painted walls.

scenes.narration: बीना ने बड़ी लड़कियों से पूछा, मैं भी खेलूँ? जवाब मिला: जगह पूरी है।
scenes.caption: Beena asked the big girls if she could play too. The answer: the spots are full.
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, stands with her hands behind her back in front of two older girls who hold the ends of a long rope and shake their heads, house walls and the lane behind them.

scenes.narration: बीना अकेले कूदती रही, बिना रस्सी। मज़ा नहीं आया। मेरे साथ बोलो: रस्सी ऊपर, रस्सी नीचे।
scenes.caption: She skipped alone, with no rope. No fun. Say with me: rope up, rope down.
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, hops up and down alone on the empty side of the lane with no rope in her hands, her braids bouncing, the older girls skipping further down the lane, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: तभी एक लड़की घर चली गई। रस्सी का सिरा ज़मीन पर गिरा। खेल रुक गया।
scenes.caption: Then one girl went home. One end of the rope hit the ground. The game stopped.
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, watches an older girl walk away towards a doorway while the loose end of the long rope lies on the concrete of the lane and the other girls stand still, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: दो छोटे बच्चे भी रस्सी माँगने लगे। बड़ी लड़कियाँ जाने लगीं। अब खेल किसका?
scenes.caption: Two little kids came asking for the rope. The big girls began leaving. Whose game now?
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, stands beside the rope while two smaller children tug at it and two of the older girls turn away towards the houses, afternoon light in the lane.

scenes.narration: बीना ने सवाल बदल दिया। उसने पूछा: मैं सिरा घुमाऊँ? रस्सी घुमाते हुए वह बोली: रस्सी ऊपर, रस्सी नीचे।
scenes.caption: Beena changed her question. Could she turn an end? Rope up, rope down, she sang.
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, holds one end of the long rope in both hands and turns it in a wide circle while an older girl turns the other end and a third girl jumps over it, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: खेल फिर चल पड़ा और बीना की बारी आई। घुमाना भी अच्छा लगा। अब मेरे साथ बोलो!
scenes.caption: The game restarted and Beena got her jump. Turning felt good too. Say it with me!
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, jumps over the turning rope in the middle of the lane while two girls turn the ends and the smaller children clap beside the wall, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: रस्सी ऊपर, रस्सी नीचे।
scenes.caption: Rope up, rope down.
scenes.image_brief: Beena, a five-year-old girl with two short braids tied with blue ribbons and a chipped red bangle on her wrist, in an orange frock, turns one end of the long rope in the lane while a line of children waits to jump and the rope arcs high above them, golden late afternoon light.

title: 😮 तनु की बोतल का ढक्कन चटक गया... चोटी तक पानी कैसे बचेगा? #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🤔 क्या तनु की तीन घूँट वाली गिनती उसे पहाड़ी की चोटी तक पहुँचाएगी? #kids
💛 तनु ने पहाड़ी रास्ते पर तीन घूँट गिने, फिर आधा पानी बह गया... #kids #story
description_hook: तनु को पहाड़ी की चोटी तक चढ़ना है और बोतल में पानी कम है। रास्ते में ढक्कन चटक जाता है।

characters.name: तनु
characters.description: eight years old, one long plait, small blue bindi, pink salwar kameez and a cloth sling bag

scenes.narration: पहाड़ी रास्ते पर तनु को चोटी चढ़नी है, पानी कम है।
scenes.caption: On the hill path, Tanu must reach the top and her water is low.
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, walks up a stony hill path between dry bushes holding a half empty plastic water bottle, the bare hilltop far above her, harsh midday sunlight on the stones.

scenes.narration: तनु ने गिनकर घूँट लिए: तीन घूँट, फिर आगे। धूप तेज़ थी। मेरे साथ गिनो!
scenes.caption: Tanu counted her sips: three sips, then on. The sun was fierce. Count with me!
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, stands on the stony path tilting the plastic bottle for a small sip, her eyes shut against the glare, the bare hillside behind her under a bright midday sun.

scenes.narration: तनु ने छाया में बैठकर घूँट बचाए। पर बोतल हल्की होती गई। चोटी अब भी दूर थी।
scenes.caption: She saved sips in the shade. The bottle kept getting lighter. The top was still far.
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, sits in the thin shade of a lone tree beside the path holding the plastic bottle up to the light to see how little water is left, hot bright sky above the hill.

scenes.narration: फिर बोतल का ढक्कन चटक गया। पानी टपका और आधा बह गया। ऊपर कोई नल नहीं है। अब क्या?
scenes.caption: Then the cap cracked. Water dripped and half was gone. No tap up there. Now what?
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, holds the plastic bottle whose cap has a wide crack, water dripping from it onto the dusty stones of the path, the bottle now half empty, bright sunlight.

scenes.narration: तनु ने बचा पानी स्टील के टिफ़िन में उड़ेला। ढक्कन बंद किया। अब मेरे साथ बोलो: तीन घूँट, फिर आगे।
scenes.caption: Tanu poured the rest into her steel tiffin and shut it. Say: three sips, then on.
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, kneels on the path pouring the last water from the cracked bottle into an open steel tiffin box balanced on a flat stone, midday sun overhead.

scenes.narration: एक बच्चा खाली बोतल लिए बैठा था। तनु ने टिफ़िन से उसे तीन घूँट दिए। आगे की चढ़ाई हल्की लगी।
scenes.caption: A boy sat with an empty bottle. Tanu gave him three sips. The climb ahead felt light.
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, tilts the steel tiffin box to pour water for a smaller boy sitting on a rock with an empty bottle beside him, dusty path and bright sky around them.

scenes.narration: तीन घूँट, फिर आगे।
scenes.caption: Three sips, then on.
scenes.image_brief: Tanu, an eight-year-old girl with one long plait and a small blue bindi, in a pink salwar kameez with a cloth sling bag, walks up the higher part of the stony path holding the closed steel tiffin box, the smaller boy walking beside her, the hilltop close ahead in bright light.

title_alts: 🤔 क्या गुड्डू की आखिरी लोई से बहन के टिफ़िन लायक गोल रोटी बनेगी? #kids

description_hook: गुड्डू की हर रोटी नक्शे जैसी बन रही है, और आटा आखिरी लोई पर आ गया है।

characters.name: गुड्डू
characters.description: nine years old, short spiky haircut, red vest and blue pyjama pants, a small bandage on his left thumb

scenes.narration: रसोई में गुड्डू आखिरी लोइयों से गोल रोटी बनाना चाहता है।
scenes.caption: In the kitchen, Guddu wants one round roti from the last balls of dough.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, stands at a low kitchen counter in front of a steel plate holding two small balls of dough and a wooden rolling pin, a round iron tava heating on the stove behind him, warm light from a kitchen window.

scenes.narration: उसने बेलन घुमाया और रोटी नक्शे जैसी निकली। गुड्डू हँसा और बोला: थपथप, थपथप, अब गोल।
scenes.caption: He rolled it out and the roti came out like a map. Pat pat, pat pat, now round.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, rolls a lopsided roti with the wooden rolling pin on a round wooden board, the flat dough shaped like a map, flour on his hands and on the counter, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: दूसरी लोई और दबाई। रोटी कोने से फट गई। तवा गरम था।
scenes.caption: He pressed the second ball harder. The roti tore at a corner. The pan was hot.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, presses a second ball of dough flat with the rolling pin and the edge of the roti is torn open, the iron tava glowing hot on the stove beside him, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: गुड्डू का आटा खत्म, एक लोई बची। छोटी बहन का टिफ़िन खाली पड़ा है।
scenes.caption: Guddu's dough is finished, one ball left. His little sister's tiffin sits empty.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, looks at an empty steel plate with one last ball of dough on it, an open empty steel tiffin box on the counter beside the plate, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: पहली रोटी तवे से चिपक गई। अब दोबारा आटा नहीं मिलेगा। टिफ़िन में क्या जाएगा?
scenes.caption: The first roti stuck to the pan. No more dough. So what goes in the tiffin?
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, stands at the stove where a darkened roti is stuck flat to the hot iron tava, the empty flour tin lying on its side on the counter, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: गुड्डू ने कटोरी उलटी रखकर आटे पर दबाई। किनारा गोल कटा। मेरे साथ बोलो: थपथप, थपथप, अब गोल।
scenes.caption: Guddu pressed a bowl upside down into the dough. Round edge. Pat pat, now round.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, presses an upside down steel bowl into flattened dough on the wooden board with a neat round cut edge appearing under the rim of the bowl, flour dust in the air, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: कतरनों से तीन नन्ही रोटियाँ बनीं। बहन का टिफ़िन भर गया। गुड्डू खिलखिला उठा। अब मेरे साथ बोलो!
scenes.caption: Three tiny rotis from the scraps. Sister's tiffin is full. Guddu giggled. Say with me!
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, puts three small round rotis into the open steel tiffin box on the counter while his younger sister watches from the kitchen doorway, warm kitchen light.

scenes.narration: थपथप, थपथप, अब गोल।
scenes.caption: Pat pat, pat pat, now round.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, a nine-year-old boy with a short spiky haircut and a small bandage on his left thumb, in a red vest and blue pyjama pants, holds up one perfectly round roti above the wooden board in the kitchen, the filled steel tiffin box beside him on the counter, warm kitchen light.
